_lees_my: Outeurs vir die blok onderaan boodskappe en artikels. Gee 'n boodskap of artikel 'n 'authors'-lys in sy index.json, bv. "authors": ["dawid-annemarie"].

bio.af: Dawid en Annemarie is 'n diakenpaar by Strome van Lewe in Boshof en is sedert 2010 deel van die Four12-familie. Hulle dien saam, lei Community en help graag mense om meer van Jesus te sien. Hulle het twee seuns en 'n dogter.
bio.en: Dawid and Annemarie are a deacon couple at Strome van Lewe in Boshof and have been part of the Four12 family since 2010. They serve together, lead Community and love helping people see more of Jesus. They have two sons and a daughter.

bio.af: Hendrik is die Hoof Ouderling van Strome van Lewe in Boshof. Hy en sy vrou Engela is sedert 2023 deel van die Four12-familie. Sedert 2015 dien Hendrik die gemeenskap van Boshof, onder meer met beradingswerk in die Boshof-gevangenis.
bio.en: Hendrik is the Lead Elder of Strome van Lewe in Boshof. He and his wife Engela have been part of the Four12 family since 2023. Since 2015 Hendrik has served the Boshof community, including counselling at Boshof prison.
